title: Characteristic drops for high-order vanishing on the hypercube
summary: Let $F$ be a field, let $0\le \ell\le k-2$, and suppose that $n\ge k-1$. We determine the minimum degree of a polynomial in $F[x_1,\ldots,x_n]$ that vanishes to order at least $k$ at every nonzero vertex of the Boolean cube and to order exactly $\ell$ at the origin. The answer is \[ n+2k-2-ρ_F(k-\ell), \] where $ρ_F(s)$ is the least number of positive integers summing to $s-1$ whose corresponding Catalan numbers are nonzero in $F$. The proof gives an explicit basis of the reduced vanishing space. In this basis the top-degree map is diagonal, with Catalan numbers on the diagonal; a refinement…
